study type: retrospective cohort study with propensity score matching analysis
cohort: The study included 114 women who had previously undergone laparoscopic myomectomy and subsequently underwent various kinds of open and laparoscopic surgeries.
finding: The use of Surgicel adhesion barrier with laparoscopic myomectomy was associated with a significantly lower frequency and severity of postoperative adhesions.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was identified as a significant predictor of postoperative adhesions development (OR: 0.16; CI: 0.06-0.45; p = 0.001).
